job_text:
Site Reliability Engineer - Meridian Payments

About the role
We process payments that have to work every second of every day. You will keep our systems reliable, reduce toil through automation, and improve our on-call experience.

Requirements
- 4+ years running large-scale production systems
- Deep experience with Linux and networking
- Experience with Kubernetes in production
- Proficiency writing automation in Python or Go
- Experience defining SLOs and monitoring reliability

Nice to have
- Experience with Terraform
- Familiarity with distributed tracing
- Exposure to incident command processes

Benefits
- Competitive salary and equity
- Generous on-call compensation
